text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're almost done with this part— 
Keep at it, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew! What a refreshing feeling! Rock 
climbing in the mountains... This truly is 
the epitome of Bakushin special training!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It really is~! Thank you so much for 
coming along with me, Cafe-san~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No... It's meaningful to me as well, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In the mountains, you feel at one with 
nature... It brings... such a peaceful 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I totally get it! I was having so much 
fun, I just blindly scrambled right up it, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can never climb like this during normal 
practice! I'm surprised at myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Enjoying the climb... That is the 
real secret to special training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then if we have even more fun, we should 
be able to climb even higher! Which 
means—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "BAKUSHIIIIN!!"

text_block_list.name: Echo
text_block_list.text: —Bakushiiiiin...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now! It's a bakushin race against our own 
echo! Let's scale this cliff before it 
fades away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'm gonna enjoy this scenery 
too! Thinkin' back to those days when I 
used to forage for wild greens—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...! That makes 3 wins and 
12 losses...! But not yet, the real 
contest starts now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat!? That mountain still has snow 
on it! It feels just like I'm back home, 
it does...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Perpetual snow... To think I'd encounter 
such a fantastical sight... If I climb 
even higher, there'll be even more...

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & Yukino
text_block_list.text: Wh-Where am I...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Look at this breathtaking view!! There are 
no cliffs left for me to climb!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"The sky feels so close... As if I could 
reach out and touch it..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! To think we could climb all 
the way up to a height like this...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm... totally exhausted 
already~...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ... Um, if... if it's alright with you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! Truly exquisite! Who knew coffee 
at the mountain summit could taste this 
good!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...If you like it... that would make 
me... happiest of all..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To think that havin' so much fun would 
lead to somethin' this wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then let's climb again just like this! 
Next time on an even bigger mountain, with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose so... That might not be a bad 
idea, either...
